goal: Publish Canonical Facts from immutable Evidence Registry inputs through the existing Gear Release and Active Season Manifest, with candidate-first verification and an explicit atomic cutover.
userValue: Players see one consistent equipment capability result across browse, Resolve, and the active Taro route: a verified socket is usable, a confirmed unsupported capability is unavailable, and only an unresolved category is pending verification.
nonGoals: Do not create a second Fact Release, Manifest, or active pointer.
Do not expose Artifact payloads, Observation details, hashes, queue state, root codes, worker state, or database configuration in player-facing UI.

Do not change a retail Active Season Manifest, merge, or claim live acceptance before the frozen manual-acceptance items are accepted by the user, final evidence is committed, main parity is proven, and retail replay parity is verified.

currentTruth.runtimeAuthority: The existing immutable Gear Release plus Active Season Manifest remains the sole published static-fact authority.

mustChange: Candidate-only Evidence Registry migration, sequential 0019 then 0020 then 0021 schema/grant verification, Artifact/Observation replay, canonical compilation, shadow review, and sealed candidate Gear Release evidence.
Candidate backend/API/Resolve/worker/timer smoke on an isolated candidate root, database, service, and port.
Active Taro gear-detail verification and an explicit existing-Manifest compare-and-swap only after user acceptance.
mustNotChange: Retail database, retail service, retail Active Season Manifest pointer, and retail release state before explicit user cutover authorization, final evidence commit, main parity, deterministic retail replay, and candidate-to-retail release parity.
Append-only Artifact, Observation, and Canonical Fact rows during Manifest rollback.
evidenceRequired: Immutable pre-candidate runtime checkpoint: final CR, committed/pushed clean exact HEAD/tree, and re-run scoped suites before candidate deployment.
Exact candidate tree/build/runtime parity and candidate database backup identity before sequential migrations 0019, 0020, and 0021.
Artifact import, Observation replay, compiler output, complete shadow classification, and sealed candidate Gear Release identity.
Candidate health, affected API, Resolve, bounded worker, timer/no-op/backflow, and fail-closed smoke evidence.

Real WeChat acceptance for every frozen manual item; then final evidence commit, main merge/push/parity/retest, deterministic retail replay/materialization parity, fresh retail Manifest CAS, and rollback proof.

ownership.factOwner: The Evidence Registry Fact Compiler seals static facts into the existing immutable Gear Release; the existing Active Season Manifest atomically selects the released authority.

engineeringHealth.reason: This is a Strict user-visible runtime cutover with PostgreSQL migration, candidate services, worker activity, a release pointer, and a Taro consumer. Local tests are insufficient; the runbook requires isolated candidate proof, user acceptance, atomic CAS, and rollback evidence.

acceptanceEvidence: The scoped Python and Taro suites pass on the exact verification head.

The isolated candidate applies only the sequentially required 0019, 0020, and 0021 migrations, verifies their schema/grants, produces immutable Artifact and Observation identities, a sealed candidate Gear Release, and a shadow report with no regression classification.
The exact candidate tree/build passes health, API, Resolve, worker, timer/no-op, and fail-closed smoke checks without retail traffic or a retail pointer change.

After the user accepts every frozen real-WeChat item, final CR/evidence commit, main merge/push/parity/retest, and deterministic retail replay/materialization prove candidate-to-retail release ID/hash/digest parity before an explicit fresh-generation existing-Manifest CAS; fresh post-CAS smoke and rollback to the recorded prior Manifest then pass.

decisionLog.decision: The implementation is Strict: candidate Gear Release and candidate deployment precede any active Manifest change, and only explicit user acceptance permits retail cutover.

Task 8 freezes three real-WeChat acceptance items: 250033/void_upgrade-298 renders one selectable socket, a verified false or zero capability renders unavailable, and unresolved evidence renders pending only for its own category. Candidate releases are not retail releases: after acceptance, retail deterministically replays the same immutable inputs/revisions and must match candidate release IDs, hashes, and digests before a fresh-generation retail CAS.
